title: RAW UNREVIEWED: graft union preserves stock and scion identities until a written fusion relation
summary: An agricultural account can keep stock and scion as distinct participants while cutting, placing and fastening them, then describe a union or failure. A pictured composite plant would constrain the attachment role rather than assert botanical ancestry. This rivals a one-plant organ-description account.
required_falsifier: Reject if the second participant is inferred only from an image, if component symmetry erases stock/scion direction, if a joint output appears without written union/result, or a whole second context requires shifting the attachment predicate.
exact_changed_research_decision: Choose explicit horticultural attachment with preserved dual identity versus static one-plant morphology only if all participant and composition obligations differ and are satisfied; this does not reopen failed new-stem transfer.

design.mechanism: Enter stock S and scion C with independent provenance; CUT(C) and PREPARE(S) do not change their identities; INSERT(C,S) introduces an attachment relation; only an explicit union/result predicate can license later joint growth. The same directed word construction must distinguish host recipient from inserted patient.
independent_constraints: Two written participants with distinct roles and a paid contact/attachment relation.
Independent image attachment geometry consistent with insertion rather than detached harvest or generic side branch.
Directed component order, wholeform residuals and subsequent reference frequencies account for preserved participants and any union state.
design.unit: Two complete prospective admitted contexts plus their independently owned image-role evidence; no target nomination or access by producer.
design.minimum_adequate_test: First audit claim-bearing predecessors and known counterexample; then root can choose one paired exploratory whole reading and only freeze a test if a distinct consequence remains.
design.budget_note: Root must set total preparation/implementation/validation/publication budget in the selected existing proposal before substantial work; this raw producer launches no experiment.
